The fix is **PR #3792, "(fix) O3-6100: Prevent duplicate vitals saves"**, merged as `0e06523b` on 2026-10-13. It changes one line in the exported vitals form's save handler: line 225 of `exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx`, where `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(` becomes `return createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(`.

The PR body says the aim is to keep "Save and close" disabled while vitals are being saved, so a double-click saves once. The Save button already has `disabled={!hasUserUnsavedChanges || isSubmitting}` (line 677), and `handleSubmit` awaits the async handler. Returning the promise is what lets react-hook-form keep `isSubmitting` true until the request settles. Without the `return`, the handler finished immediately and the button re-enabled while the save was still pending. I confirmed this from the diff and the file at the merge commit, not by running the form. The PR also adds 71 lines of test coverage in `vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx`, which I did not open.

Evidence, best first:
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx` line 225: the changed line.
- Same file, lines 225–232: the save call and its `.then` chain.
- Same file, lines 673–681: the "Save and close" button and its `disabled` condition.
- PR #3792 (merged as `0e06523b`) and its diff, which touches only that file and the test file.
- Commit `033aa05a` is the last reviewed commit on the PR.
